Executed 23 of 38 test cases against the 5 entities present in the qa tenant. The headline finding is SN-10-BE001: POST /core/api/v1/entities returns HTTP 500 for a payload that returned 201 on 2026-05-28 -- a server-side regression that blocks all entity creation. Because creation is down, 1 TCs are BLOCKED (creation, RunGroup invariants, edit, deactivate) and the fresh PRIMARY / SECONDARY / MULTI_RG test data the suite needs cannot be built. Read-only checks confirmed several SNOPS fixes (lock icon, AUTO badges, Date Format, MY/ID Soon badge) but also surfaced that the v1.2 Payroll Run Groups UI is not implemented and the create form still lacks the Contact Information section (SNOPS-19).

#1 SN-10-BE001 P1 SNOPS-61 FIXED 2026-06-01

SN-10-BE001 -- Entity CREATE API returns HTTP 500 for valid payload (regression)

POST /core/api/v1/entities returns an empty-body HTTP 500 for the exact payload shape that returned 201 on 2026-05-28 (same user, fresh valid bearer, valid entityAdminEmployeeId re-fetched from Test TH Regional). GET endpoints on the same token/tenant return 200, so auth is valid -- the failure is isolated to the create handler. No entity can be created via API or UI; this blocks tenant onboarding and the entire create test path.

#9 SN-10-BE002 P2 To file NEW 2026-06-01

SN-10-BE002 -- Server-side registration validation not enforced (found on 2026-06-01 retest)

With CREATE working again, the API accepts invalid registration values that spec ENT-8.1 defines with strict patterns: tax_id = "12345" (5 digits, expected ^\d{13}$) -> HTTP 201; branch_number = "123" (expected ^\d{5}$) -> 201; short_code = "AB" (2 chars, min 3) -> 201. Invalid Thai tax IDs / branch numbers can be persisted; the API contract is not enforced server-side. Previously masked by the CREATE 500.

#12 SN-10-FE-NEW P3 To file STILL OPEN 2026-06-06

SN-10-FE-NEW -- Silent 403 write failures: no error toast or banner when Deactivate / Reactivate / Create 403s

When write operations (Deactivate, Reactivate, Create) return HTTP 403, the UI shows no error toast, no banner, and no state change feedback. Clicking "Deactivate Entity" or "Reactivate Entity" from the kebab menu under a write-restricted account produces zero UI response -- the operation silently fails. Admins may incorrectly assume the action succeeded. Matches the silent-failure UX pattern flagged in SN-6. Found 2026-06-05 (johnangelol regression run; all write attempts 403'd). Write-403 artifact resolved for richardtest on 2026-06-06 -- UX defect itself remains unfiled.

#13 SN-10-FE012 P1 To file NEW 2026-06-06

SN-10-FE012 -- Entity Admin Name field marked required (*) silently blocks entity creation with no error toast

Filling all visible required fields and clicking "Add Entity" causes the form to remain on /settings/entities/new with no navigation, no toast, and no banner. Inspection reveals the Entity Admin Information "Name" field has a red border at submit time despite no visible required-field indicator before submit. Spec ENT-9.1 states all contact info fields are optional. This is a regression from the SNOPS-19 partial fix understanding -- the Name field is marked required in the DOM, and submit-time constraint validation silently blocks the POST. Entity creation is fully blocked for any user who does not fill the optional Name field.

#14 SN-10-FE013 P1 To file NEW 2026-06-06

SN-10-FE013 -- Entity Admin (johnangelol) has Global Admin-level access to all 23 entities -- cross-entity scoping anomaly

johnangelol (assigned Entity Admin for Acme SG Central only) sees all 23 entities in the list, an "Add Entity" button, and per-entity kebab menus with "Edit Entity" and "Deactivate Entity" options. Expected: only Acme SG Central visible; no "Add Entity"; kebab shows "View" only; detail panel shows no "Edit Entity" footer button. The scoping failure means Entity Admins have effectively Global Admin rights across all tenant entities. This corroborates the cross-tenant scoping anomaly flagged in SN-70 NEW-BE-H3 and confirms the RBAC wiring for Entity Admin role is not enforced at the entities list layer.

1. CREATE regression (SN-10-BE001). Same payload that created "QA API Demo Bangkok" (201) on 2026-05-28 now returns 500 with an empty body. GETs succeed on the same token -- isolated to the create handler.

2. Two-layer failure on create. Even before the 500, the FE never surfaces backend errors (SN-10-FE001) -- the create path fails silently end-to-end.

3. v1.2 not shipped in FE. Payroll Run Groups (the headline v1.2 amendment) is absent from both the create form and the detail panel.

4. GET-with-Content-Type 400. Sending Content-Type: application/json on a GET (no body) returns 400 (serializer error) -- same REST-hygiene issue as SN-26-BE003.

5. Per-terminal Playwright profile works. This run used PW_TERMINAL=1 -> .pw-profiles/1, resolving the cross-terminal "Browser is already in use" lock. The profile-1 browser dropped twice under the entities-list polling loop -- a stability concern unrelated to SN-10 functionality.
